text:
sam: Heads-up — PR #18888 is showing nondeterministic snapshot diffs on the macOS runtime job. image-renderer/smoke failing with pixel diffs that sometimes pass locally. Can someone help triage? Unsure if we should rerun, bump snapshots, or mark flaky.

anya: Link to the build?

sam: https://buildkite.com/redwood/prs/18888/builds/432 — main failing job is `macos-runtime-3`. Snippet from the failing assertion: ```AssertionError: images differ by 12 pixels
Expected: /artifacts/baseline/image-123.png
Actual:   /artifacts/current/image-123.png
Diff:     /artifacts/diff/image-123.png```

ci-bot: Buildkite: build 432 failed on job macos-runtime-3 (exit code 1).

michael: Is this new to this PR or have we seen similar diffs recently?

sam: I grepped yesterday's CI — saw a couple unrelated PRs with tiny diffs in the same test. Looks like noise, not model-level regression.

tess: Sounds like snapshot noise. Can we do a targeted rerun for that job and collect full screenshots? Also check TZ/locale. On buildkite you can run: ```bk rerun --job macos-runtime-3 432``` or locally: ```./scripts/test.sh --filter image-renderer/smoke --platform macos --record```

sam: Kicking off targeted rerun now.

anya: If rerun is flaky, we should avoid auto-approving a snapshot bump. Post the diff images here so I can eyeball them.

sam: Posted diff: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/diff-image-123.png — looks like a 1-2px darkening on the shadow edge. Could be antialiasing timing.

michael: If the rerun passes twice, I'm okay with approving a snapshot update, but prefer we also add an infra ticket to reduce flakiness (timeout/tolerance tweak).

tess: Also try adding TZ=UTC in the job env — mac image tests have bitten us before due to locale rendering jitter. Example env change in pipeline: `env: { TZ: UTC }`.

sam: Rerun #1 passed. Queuing a second pass with TZ=UTC as @tess suggested.

ci-bot: Rerun queued: build 433 (macos-runtime-3).

anya: I can review the diffs after the second pass. If it consistently passes, we can either accept the new snapshot or patch tolerance. Don't merge until we have a clear path.

sam: Second pass also passed. I'm going to hold for one more quick verification (or until end of day) and then upload the new golden if nothing else pops.

tess: If you do upload, please add a short note in the PR description referencing this thread and the infra ticket (if you open one). Makes audits easier.

michael: :eyes: — thanks for handling the reruns.

sam: Decision plan: 1) Wait for one more short rerun (will run before lunch). 2) If stable, push snapshot update and ping @anya for review/approve. 3) Open infra task to increase tolerance / add TZ=UTC to mac job. 4) If it flips again, mark PR hold and file a flaky-test issue.

ci-bot: Rerun finished: build 433 passed (macos-runtime-3).

sam: Third quick pass succeeded. I'll upload the new snapshots to the PR and request @anya to approve the update; also creating infra ticket for follow-up.

anya: Thanks — I'll review the snapshot diff once it's posted. Please add the ticket link and tag the test with `@flaky` if we need short-term mitigation.

sam: Will do. Thanks all for the fast help — updating thread after I push the snapshot.
